caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, abstract floral design centered on a beige or off-white background. The composition consists of a large central flower-like shape formed by scalloped, wavy outlines in brown, tan, pink, and a darker blue, with a small solid blue oval at the very center. Radiating from the center are four sets of paired, branching forms that resemble leaves or petals, each outlined in colors including brown, tan, blue, and pink. The forms are distributed evenly around the center, creating a balanced, cross-like arrangement. The colors are flat and solid, with no gradients or shading, and the lines are bold and undulating. In the lower left corner, there is a small area of handwritten text in black ink. The background remains largely unadorned and provides a neutral space that contrasts with the vivid colors of the patterned elements.
title: Colcha
